hints.title: Subarray Target Element
hints.text: To make all elements in a contiguous block of length x equal with minimal adjustments, the optimal target value is the middle element of the sorted block.

hints.title: Sliding Window Cost Evaluation
hints.text: Calculate the transformation cost for every window of size x across the array.

hints.title: Non-Overlapping Interval Selection
hints.text: Use a table where each state represents choosing a certain number of non-overlapping windows up to the current position.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: X: length of each target subarray
K: number of subarrays to select
complexity.notes: Median minimization determines optimal local costs, and tabular transitions select disjoint intervals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive search over all subsets of disjoint intervals requires exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing window costs allows linear recurrence per state.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the median property for absolute deviations and formulate the recurrence.
